about: Not covered. The complex towed the tenant's car over an expired parking sticker. Expected: nothing the tool covers applies (the classifier gives only 'other', or the tenant says no to any suggestion), so it stops before the chat. Since 2026-10-02 the stop also lists the situations the tool covers and shows the lease's own clause on the subject (Lease Section 5.4, Vehicles).
start: I came out this morning and my car was gone. My apartment complex had it towed from my own parking spot because my parking permit sticker expired yesterday.
It cost me $250 to get it back. Can they do that?
